name: services/slips/delete_template
description:
Delete an existing template.

Important: Only some templates can be directly deleted (drafts and possibly some more specific cases). Others should be marked as obsolete and wait to be garbage-collected.

arguments.name: tpl_id
arguments.description: ID of the template to be deleted.

arguments.name: format
arguments.description: Format in which to return values. See supported output formats.

arguments.name: callback
arguments.description: Required only if you've chosen jsonp as a return format.

returns:
{"success": true}

In case of failure, use the user_messages field to display a proper message for the user.
